correctness.rationale: The discrete case uses pointwise Sh(X)=Set^X: an ultrafilter selects one label in any finite partition, making binary-coproduct comparison bijective and initial comparison an isomorphism. For nonisolated x in clopen Hausdorff X, take clopen-neighbourhood index set I and ultrafilter extending all tails T_V={U subseteq V}. For each large J, intersection_{U in J}U={x}, since every y≠x is excluded by some V and J intersects T_V. Characteristic functions 1_U are global sections of 1+1, assembling to a global section of the product and hence ultraproduct. Its stalk at x cannot equal either constant coproduct-image germ: 0 fails at x, 1 would require one common neighbourhood W contained in intersection J={x}, contradicting nonisolation. Filtered-colimit and stalk equality are applied in the correct order; no invalid interchange of infinite product and stalk. Empty and infinite discrete cases follow.
